image_description: A close-up portrait of a tabby cat sitting upright. The cat has a brown and grey coat with distinct black stripes (mackerel pattern), a white chest patch, and green-yellow eyes. It is looking directly at the camera. The background consists of blurred blue and brown surfaces, likely furniture or walls.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The white fur on the chest appears slightly overly smooth and uniform compared to the detailed texture of the striped fur, lacking individual strand definition in the center mass. This is a common AI artifact where high-contrast solid areas lose micro-texture.

artifact_observations.location: Right ear tip and background boundary
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness/bleeding at the very tip of the right ear against the blue background. While this could be depth-of-field, the edge lacks the crispness seen on the left ear, suggesting minor generation inconsistency.
